notes.title: £7777=7 endings; New goal
notes.content:
[b]Hello to all backers =)[/b]

We are on the verge of breaking our third stretch goal which is £ 6900, so with 70 hours left to go, can we hit our fourth goal? 

Our new fourth stretch goal is for £7777. If we achieve this goal, we will make 7 endings instead of 4. Now we want to make 3 endings for girls and one harem, but if we get this goal, then we will make 6 endings for girls (3 good and 3 bad) and one harem.

Don't forget we also have a [url=https://discord.gg/cZmrrzh]discord[/url] where you can write your Feedback on the demo version. We'd love to hear from you in there and talk to you live in person!

[b]Thanks for your attention![/b]

[i]~ Midnight Hearts ~[/i]

notes.title: The £6200 stretch goal has been hit! Bring on the next stretch goal; £6900.
notes.content:
[b]Hey all![/b] Thank to everyone so far for your wonderful support, we were able to hit £6200 in pledges and we're happy to now announce that upon launch an additional story will be for you.

We've added a new stretch goal of £6900. If we achieve this goal, we can make more character poses and a few more illustrations.

Don't forget we also have a [url=https://discord.gg/cZmrrzh]discord[/url] where you can write your Feedback on the demo version. We'd love to hear from you in there and talk to you live in person!

Thanks for your attention!

[i]~ Midnight Hearts ~[/i]

notes.title: 100%! We did it! and some news
notes.content:
[b]Hello to all supporters =) [/b]We have finally collected 100%! Thanks to everyone who supported us.

We have now updated our goals. If get £6200, then we will make a little story about the first Amanda and Jacob festival together. It will be free for anyone who has supported from £ 12. Plus we were given a week for our fundraising. Hopefully during this time we can collect more additional money for goals. And now there are major refands, but thanks to all new people who support us and do not let us go down. 

Don't forget we also have a [url=https://discord.gg/cZmrrzh]discord [/url]where you can write your Feedback on demo version. 

Also some people could help us with translation into Spanish, this is not 100% but it is possible. We would also like to translate into German and Chinese, if you want to help with this (for free), that would be very good. 

Thanks for your attention!

[b]~ Midnight Hearts ~[/b]

notes.title: Relaunching of the Kickstarter Project
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone for their past support of Cosplay Convention Crisis.

It's with pleasure that I announce we will be re-launching the kickstarter project with the new date of:

                                                                      [b]24th July 2020![/b]

You can sign up to be notified of the kickstarter via this link, we're very excited for this push.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thehiddenlevels/cosplay-convention-crisis-0

We have taken into account our past experience from running our first Kickstarter, and will be lowering the total goal to £5,500. 

If you could help spread word by sharing the link, we'd truly appreciate it.

We feel that Cosplay Convention Crisis is needed much more now than ever due to the pandemic and not being able to actually attend Cosplays or Expos!

Thank you for your time and support.
